stages.txd: 32 byte PCI TXD after construction, before TXP fill/enqueue; queued descriptor only
stages.tx_status: bounded MAC RX TXS record prefix before existing format/PID/WCID filters; source-reported status only

unknown: unavailable integer fields -1; generation_known=0; never construct association/link lifetime from token/PID/WCID/sample
sample: counter scoped by stage plus boot/device; TXD and TXS counters are distinct namespaces, never a shared packet ID
hex: exact 32 descriptor bytes in source byte order, compact %*phN; d0..d7 are little-endian words converted to host integers

observed_len.tx_status: validated dispatcher record size 32 or 48; for 48 only first32 retained, last16 unobserved

txd.pid: mt76_tx_status_skb_add returned PID; not necessarily a tracked PID
txd.wcid: selected host wcid index, including global fallback
txd.link_phy: only host peer entry if wcid->sta is available; else -1
txd.qid: requested mt76 queue enum, not hardware qidx
txd.wlan: raw descriptor WLAN_IDX; kept separate from host selected wcid
txd.seq: raw descriptor sequence bits; SN_VALID must be checked in raw d3 before treating it as configured sequence; never OTA proof

txs.skbaddr: NULL; no borrowed TX buffer/reply join
txs.wlan: raw descriptor WCID bits, not resolved host identity
txs.wcid_link_phy: read-only RCU snapshot only for supported format and existing bounded-index entry; no peer generation proof
txs.status_supported: non-MT7928 connac3 raw TXS format 0 or 1 only
txs.acked: -1 if unsupported; otherwise !(d0 & MT_TXS0_ACK_ERROR_MASK), exact existing source interpretation; not network delivery
txs.coverage: MAC mt7925_rx_check and mt7925_queue_rx_skb only; MCU UNI_EVENT_TX_DONE_RAW/MSG not instrumented

parent_integration: Map this new trace name using stage only after recognizing the schema. Decode display fields only when exact source-layout file hash is bound. Before generic packet-path analysis, REMOVE acked for value -1 or unsupported/unmatched layout; do not turn it into false. Do not infer ACK from raw words without layout binding. Retain source-reported ACK, release, semaphore/credit observations and stack delivery as distinct dimensions. No token/skb/pid joins across absent lifetime.
